SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.actor) AS new_stars
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE r.name = 'openai/codex' AND e.type = 'WatchEvent'
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'

SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name
ORDER BY collaboration_events DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_contributors
FROM (
  SELECT e.actor
  FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
  WHERE r.name = 'openclaw/openclaw'
    AND e.type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
    AND e.actor IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(LOWER(e.actor), 5) <> '[bot]'
    AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
    AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
) AS contributors

SELECT COUNT(*) AS push_events
FROM events
WHERE type = 'PushEvent'
  AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE r.name = 'huggingface/transformers'
  AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'

SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.actor) AS new_stars
FROM repos AS r LEFT JOIN events AS e ON e.repo_id = r.repo_id
  AND e.type = 'WatchEvent'
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name
ORDER BY new_stars DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS pull_request_events
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE r.name = 'microsoft/vscode' AND e.type = 'PullRequestEvent'
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-10 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-14 00:00:00'

WITH contributors AS (
  SELECT e.actor,
    CASE WHEN e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
         THEN 'previous' ELSE 'last' END AS week
  FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
  WHERE r.name = 'langchain-ai/langchain'
    AND e.type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
    AND e.actor IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(LOWER(e.actor), 5) <> '[bot]'
    AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
    AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.actor, week HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE week = 'previous') AS previous_week_contributors,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE week = 'last') AS last_week_contributors
FROM contributors

SELECT CAST(e.created_at AS DATE) AS event_date, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE r.name = 'vercel/next.js'
  AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date ASC

WITH contributors AS (
  SELECT repo_id, actor
  FROM events
  WHERE type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
    AND actor IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(LOWER(actor), 5) <> '[bot]'
    AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY repo_id, actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COUNT(c.actor) AS active_contributors
FROM repos AS r LEFT JOIN contributors AS c ON c.repo_id = r.repo_id
GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name
ORDER BY active_contributors DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fork_events
FROM events
WHERE type = 'ForkEvent'
  AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'

SELECT r.name AS repo_name
FROM repos AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM events AS e
  WHERE e.repo_id = r.repo_id
    AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
    AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
)
ORDER BY repo_name ASC

SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.actor) AS new_stars
FROM repos AS r LEFT JOIN events AS e ON e.repo_id = r.repo_id
  AND e.type = 'WatchEvent'
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
WHERE r.language = 'Python'
GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name
ORDER BY new_stars DESC, repo_name ASC

SELECT r.name AS repo_name
FROM repos AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM events AS e
  WHERE e.repo_id = r.repo_id
    AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
    AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
    AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
)
ORDER BY repo_name ASC

WITH contributors AS (
  SELECT e.repo_id, e.actor
  FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
  WHERE r.name IN ('996icu/996.ICU', 'deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness', 'sindresorhus/awesome', 'openai/codex', 'openclaw/openclaw')
    AND e.type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
    AND e.actor IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(LOWER(e.actor), 5) <> '[bot]'
    AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
    AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.repo_id, e.actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COUNT(c.actor) AS active_contributors
FROM repos AS r LEFT JOIN contributors AS c ON c.repo_id = r.repo_id
WHERE r.name IN ('996icu/996.ICU', 'deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness', 'sindresorhus/awesome', 'openai/codex', 'openclaw/openclaw')
GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name ORDER BY repo_name ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_release_repositories
FROM repos AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM events AS e
  WHERE e.repo_id = r.repo_id AND e.type = 'ReleaseEvent'
    AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
    AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
)

WITH top_repos AS (
  SELECT repo_id, name, stars FROM repos
  ORDER BY stars DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT r.name AS repo_name, r.stars AS stars, COUNT(e.event_id) AS collaboration_events
FROM top_repos AS r LEFT JOIN events AS e ON e.repo_id = r.repo_id
  AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name, r.stars
ORDER BY stars DESC, repo_name ASC

SELECT stars, forks, open_issues
FROM repos WHERE name = 'codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x'

SELECT name AS repo_name, forks
FROM repos ORDER BY forks DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repo_count FROM repos WHERE language IS NULL

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS repo_count, SUM(stars) AS total_stars
FROM repos WHERE language IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY repo_count DESC, total_stars DESC, language ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT e.type, COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE r.name = 'torvalds/linux'
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
GROUP BY e.type ORDER BY event_count DESC, e.type ASC

SELECT r.language, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events
FROM events AS e JOIN repos AS r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id
WHERE r.language IS NOT NULL
  AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')
  AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00'
  AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
GROUP BY r.language ORDER BY collaboration_events DESC, r.language ASC
